title: Art. 3.10 — Annex 9 - Facilitation, Chapter 3 - Entry and Departure of Persons and Their Baggage, C. Security of travel documents, 3.10
content: Contracting States shall promptly report accurate information about stolen, lost, and revoked travel documents, issued by their State, to INTERPOL for inclusion in the Stolen and Lost Travel Documents (SLTD) database.
